items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: Von Gammon was the drummer then... And he had Von Gammon on drums.

ctx.x: In Jack Yates's studio up there. Jack Yates.

And Von Gammon was the drummer then. Yeah. Von Gammon and Von had a nose for money, boy. And as you know, Perranti, he wouldn't pay anybody. So he rang me up one morning over. He says, come on. He says, we're going to make a recording session. And I said, okay. So Von Gammon says, go ahead. Come on over there. He says, we'll go. No, no, no tune. No name. No nothing. I don't know. It was just started off. E flat. Start off. And Perranti started playing. And he had Charlie Hartman on trombone. And he had Von Gammon…
He was from New York? No, no.
